title: cs daily scratchpad - QBRs & renewals
body:
Daily scratchpad - QBR prep, renewals, support follow-ups

Date: 2026-04-05
Owner: Grace Liu

Top priorities for today:
- Acme Corp QBR (2026-04-09) - finalize deck and run internal dry-run.
  - Collect top 5 usage stats (tokens, peak RPS, errors) - assigned to Ethan, due 2026-04-07.
  - Add ROI slide: cost savings from batching changes (compare Feb vs Mar) - ask product analytics for numbers (Samira).
  - Confirm attendee list and time (ask contact: tina@acme.com) - follow up if no reply by 04/06.

- Zenith Media renewal (term end 2026-04-20) - $120k ARR upsell opportunity.
  - Renewal owner: Grace.
  - Action: confirm current usage and forecast + list of outstanding support tickets.
  - Send renewal reminder + rough contract outline by 04/08.
  - Risk: latency regressions last month flagged by engineering; need mitigation plan before upsell.

- Orion Health support follow-ups:
  - Ticket #CS-3145 (embedding mismatch) - engineering fix targeted 2026-04-06. Check deploy status before EOD.
  - Schedule 30-min troubleshooting call post-deploy with product eng (requested Samira).

Quick TODOs / checklist:
- [ ] Pull per-account token spend for top 10 accounts (dashboard) - do today.
- [ ] Draft Acme QBR deck outline (cover, usage, incidents, roadmap, asks).
- [ ] Update renewal tracker sheet for Zenith & Nova Labs.
- [ ] Confirm billing adjustments for Nova Labs (discount approved by finance).
- [ ] Create follow-up notes template for QBRs (standardize outcomes + action owners).

Notes to self / talking points for QBRs:
- Highlight cost savings from Redwood Optimize: batching + KV cache impact (include numbers).
- Blueprint for graceful degradation: fallback model + regional routing - call out any ops required by customer.
- For Acme, emphasize roadmap alignment: private deployment pilot option and SLAs for Dedicated.

Risks / blockers:
- Latency regression for small-batch inference (reported 03/28) - currently being triaged by serving-runtime. Need ETA and temporary mitigations for QBR.
- Missing usage numbers from analytics for 03/20-03/25 window (dashboard gap). Ticketed CONFLUENCE-ACCOUNTS-QBR-9876.

Calendar & meetings:
- 2026-04-06 10:00 PT - internal QBR dry-run (Ethan, Samira, Eng lead).
- 2026-04-07 14:00 PT - call with Acme stakeholders (TBD confirm).
- 2026-04-08 09:00 PT - renewal outreach email to Zenith (include contract skeleton).

Follow-up actions (who to ping):
- Ping engineering on latency fix - @eng-serving-runtime (Samira already pinged).
- Ping product analytics for Feb/Mar cost breakdown (Ethan).
- Finance: confirm renewal pricing floor for Zenith and discount approval for Nova Labs.

Scratch ideas / reminders:
- Consider adding an "operational runbook" slide to QBR template that lists incident contacts and escalation path.
- If Acme asks for private deployment pilot, prepare checklist of required security controls and timeline (linked to Confluence page).

End notes: keep this doc informal. Move finalized QBR deck and meeting notes into shared_drives/customer-success/qbrs/ after dry-run.
